summary:
Implementation plan to fix the pet profile image upload and display flow. Addresses:
1. Inconsistent ImageKit response parsing in MyPets.jsx (align with working VetRegister/VetProfile pattern)
2. Missing Edit Pet functionality (add edit modal with image re-upload)
3. Ensuring pet images always come from MongoDB-persisted URLs, not stale state

Key finding: The `photo-1543466835-00a7907e9de1` URL is NOT used as a pet image anywhere — only decoratively in Login/Home pages.

Includes one open question about whether PUT /api/pets/:id endpoint exists on the backend.
